race.comment: HOLY TERROR (3) looks the one to beat after being beaten a head at Eagle Farm over 1000m. Strips fitter and gets a key switch in Maloney. Suspect he relishes the rise to 1200m. VOLCANIC RUSH (11) profiles similarly and looms the main danger, also debuting with a second place finish at Eagle Farm, where he was forced wide near the 900m yet was beaten just under a length. CAVALLUNA (1) is fitter third-up and gets first-time blinkers after a fair fifth at Eagle Farm. Can improve sharply. BURNT ENDS (12) is an interesting debutant for the Dwyer camp. Has been readied with two recent trials at the Sunny Coast and is one to keep in mind.
